propositions: Four criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) generated zero findings across 7,900 agentic runs due to missing vocabulary in triggers, causing wasted execution.

A deterministic pre-filter gate using audit-derived trigger regexes and file_impact conditions must fire before LLM routing, skipping criteria only when subject vocabulary is entirely absent, while preserving LLM applicability judgment.

Overlay criteria (T13, T14) and leaf criteria (removal-rationale, asserted-capability) require separate gate rule tables evaluated in route_criteria, with skips recorded as coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id and rule name.

asserted-capability must require conjunction of both text_all legs (module-ref and capability-verb) to fire; T14 and removal-rationale must also fire on file_impact alone via glob patterns and reason regex when description text does not match.
